violations.text: Cutting board observed on top the hand-washing sink. A hand-washing sink must not be used for purposes other than hand washing. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/09/2026

(Shelled eggs) was observed held at (66) degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling.PIC voluntarily disposed of product. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/09/2026

(Dried beans) packaged in the food establishment are lacking labels. Food packaged in a food establishment must be labeled with the common name of the food, a list of ingredients, the quantity of the contents, and the business name/address. New Violation. Correct By: 06/09/2026

The presence of (flies ) is not controlled as evidenced by (activity). The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests must be controlled by routinely inspecting the premises for evidence of pests, using acceptable methods to control pests, eliminating harborage conditions, and routinely inspecting incoming shipments of food and supplies. New Violation. Correct By: 06/09/2026

The door to the outside, located in the (front retail), is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 06/09/2026
The non-food contact surfaces of the (meat display cooler and prep table shelves) have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. New Violation. Correct By: 06/09/2026

The floors in walk in cooler and meat dept have an accumulation of soil residue and/or food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 06/09/2026
The (ceilings ) in the (walk in freezer ) area is in poor repair. Observed chipping paint. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 06/09/2026
Dishes and chemicals were observed in the hand-washing sink. A hand-washing sink must not be used for purposes other than hand washing. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 04/04/2024
The receptacle in the women's toilet room is lacking a cover. A toilet room used by females shall be provided with a covered receptacle for sanitary napkins. New Violation. Correct By: 04/04/2024
The ceiling in the meat walk in cooler area is in poor repair(chipping paint). The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 04/04/2024
